verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs explicitly state typo tolerance is built-in and customizable ('important ways to customize just how tolerant a search experience should be'), and community comments independently praise typo acceptance as a standout feature. Missing for 10: deeper documentation of specific tunable parameters (e.g., per-attribute typo settings, min word size for typos) beyond the overview page, and third-party technical validation of edge-case tuning.
